title: Admit unqualified monitoring judgments to guarded capture-only proposals
summary: Supply the missing Matter-owned study admission between durable unqualified monitoring answers and capture-only attention proposals. KS-1124 currently uses a genuinely deterministic approved-intent host rule while keeping model answers as unqualified notes. A new explicit path should let actual model judgments drive isolated study captures without fabricating a supported source claim, qualified method, native assessment or delivery authority.
in_scope: An explicitly opted-in, versioned capture admission for the exact existing civic monitoring objective/novelty questions derived from MAT-034, consuming actual current MAT-030 receipts and retaining unqualified provenance.
Reuse of MAT-072 access/egress, actual committed budgets, exact attempts, current source/context/disposition dependencies, real observed capture history and the existing isolated capture callback.
A negotiated wire extension and pinned SDK handoff naming the request, result, baseline and HostMonitoringState differences needed by StateCivics KS-1124/1125/1126.
out_of_scope: Production notification delivery, provider qualification/certificates, source-authority changes, automatic activation or replacing the actual deterministic host rule with a falsely not_required model method.
StateCivics implementation, image builds, dashboard lifecycle/pilot choices, county-place support, Workbench/state-intel activation, retrieval/storage/queue replacements and custom alert writing.
SQLite regression repair (MAT-083), DIAT, PostgreSQL and inventing another rehearsal or evaluation infrastructure.
implementation: Owner and KS-1124 consumer authorized implementation from ffdb9a4. Implement SDK 0.1.0.dev16 and opt-in monitoring-handoff/1.1.0 beside unchanged frozen 1.0.0. Publish recorded two-audience and mixed-baseline vectors before freeze; KS-1124 must run them in its SDK image before 1.1 is frozen.

Reuse actual durable semantic receipt validation, original/reused execution provenance, exact numeric and whole-batch admission, original control token and question/model/packet/intent bindings. A standalone probability, detached BatchResult, altered receipt, failed sibling or unresolved execution cannot acquire capture admission.

Reuse the existing ability to persist an explicitly unqualified semantic admission. Add only bounded capture policy/proposal composition where existing ports do not provide it. Do not change SemanticAdmission qualification to qualified/not_required, counterfeit an assessment, or map a model relevance answer to a supported source claim. Capture classification is a separate study decision.

Define a server-owned, immutable capture policy with explicit positive/negative/abstention regions and exact question/precision bindings. It is a study selection policy, not an accuracy target or certificate. Objective and novelty remain separate, with no multiplied importance score. Missing/uncertain/failed answers remain unknown and do not trigger a generic human question.

Reuse neutral mechanical constraints for ownership, current purpose/audience, coverage, feedback, baseline novelty, source corrections and deadlines without introducing a parallel attention engine or feeding counterfeit source assessments into the core. Any necessary neutral refactoring must preserve legacy behavior and keep civic/JEV vocabulary in the adapter.

Register the capture admission against actual original execution, source finding/packet, intent/context components, policy, dispositions and applicable observed baseline. Current pause/revoke, edits, grant withdrawal and relevant source changes withhold old results; preference-only refresh preserves authorized semantic reuse. Never renew original work tokens or resend unresolved provider/capture attempts.

Inspect the existing receipt/cache reuse gate before extending it. If qualified classification is currently required, use a separately typed capture-only reuse eligibility or withhold that reuse; never label an unqualified method qualified to obtain a cache hit. Exact-command recovery and the original execution identity remain separate from semantic reuse and empirical trials.

Add explicit 1.1.0 result provenance: native_attention retains a real assessment reference; unqualified_model_capture has assessment_reference null and exact capture-admission/execution/policy/question provenance. Extend observed-capture baseline provenance for this second kind without fabricating an assessment or delivered milestone. Keep qualification unqualified, permitted_use capture_only and consequential_use false.

Keep existing HostMonitoringState fields and source_finding meaning. The proposed optional capture_policy pin defaults to None; model capture also needs an explicitly configured trusted host admission service. Neither wire JSON nor a raw probability can supply that authority. Final callable names, shapes and policy details must be frozen and tested before KS-1124 switches.

Verify paired positive/quiet model judgments over the same authorized source and contrasting audiences, duplicates/provider jitter, observed baselines, linked corrections/new deadlines after handled feedback, unknown outcomes, partial coverage, in-flight edits/revocation, replay cuts and production-port refusal. Reuse existing synthetic fixtures and capture sinks; keep recorded conformance separate from fresh live interpretation and MAT-040 qualification.

Publish the exact implemented version, API/wire/HostMonitoringState diff, source/wheel hashes, imports and installed checks for KS-1124. Its replacement of the deterministic fallback and KS-1126 receiving acceptance remain StateCivics work; no feature availability is claimed by this ticket's plan.
Export conveyed-material capture identity as one function shared with StateCivics; no duplicate delivery-key implementation.

Share a source-only reading across independently authorized audiences, keeping each objective/novelty execution bound to its own audience access. Prefer typed capture-only reuse eligibility, never a false qualified classifier.
No default policy thresholds. The owner configures study regions explicitly; 0.8/0.2 are only prior KS-1121/example values, with the gap abstaining as unknown.

Current candidate uses a separate stored CaptureAdmission, not a native SemanticAdmission or assessment. It composes the existing receipt/control/dependency ports and shared neutral routing. Explicit native PrecisionProfile values are bound in the immutable capture policy and checked against current/original execution assumptions. No reviewer/certificate identity is invented to instantiate qualification services.

acceptance.criterion: Actual unqualified model judgments can select a study capture without a fabricated source claim, assessment or qualification.
acceptance.verification: With actual persisted semantic receipts, change the exact objective/novelty answers while holding source facts and approved contexts fixed; assert a justified positive versus quiet/unknown study proposal, exact unqualified provenance and unchanged source findings. Reject raw/detached/altered/cross-context answers and any claim that the method is qualified or not_required.

acceptance.criterion: Capture-only admission retains the existing permission, budget, receipt, freshness and uncertainty boundaries.
acceptance.verification: Use real native access/control/budget/execution services and actual context/source/grant mutations before I/O, after I/O and at capture. Assert correct refusal/withholding, original token identity, no blind resend, preserved received/unknown outcomes and no foreign-client read or future-evidence capture.

acceptance.criterion: Study captures preserve honest baselines, duplicate silence and correction/deadline semantics across replay and live-shaped inputs.
acceptance.verification: Compare deterministic traces for the same availability-ordered inputs with recorded answers in both serializations. Assert no duplicate capture for exact replay, reprint or provider-score jitter over unchanged material; unknown capture is not absent history; an actual linked correction or materially new deadline is not suppressed by old handled feedback. Baselines reference actual captures, not synthetic native assessments or delivery success.

acceptance.criterion: Unqualified study admission cannot enter consequential assessment or production delivery through ordinary supported ports.
acceptance.verification: Attempt native assessment/publication, qualified semantic use and normal DeliveryService consumption with the study admission/proposal. Assert rejection with no source mutation, certificate, production send or baseline advancement. Only the explicitly installed isolated sink may capture after its atomic guard, with qualification unqualified and consequential_use false.

acceptance.criterion: The released SDK provides an explicit, backward-compatible migration handoff rather than changing the frozen 1.0 path silently.
acceptance.verification: Freeze the negotiated new version with positive/negative compatibility vectors and actual exported callables. Run legacy 1.0 contract/adapter checks, new branch/admission checks and installed wheel imports/schema/provenance checks. Publish actual source/package hashes and receiving instructions; keep the target version marked unreleased until those receipts exist.

tests: Two contrasting audiences, same shared source, actual persisted model answers: positive, confident quiet and abstention/unknown remain distinct.
Whole-batch failure, detached/forged/reused/foreign receipts, changed questions/models/precision and exhausted or stale budget allocations.
Intent/context/preference/source/permission edits around provider completion and atomic capture, with original token preservation.
Observed native and study captures, missing/unknown outcome, provider jitter, duplicate/reprint, linked correction and new deadline after handled feedback.
Future-available evidence and historical source cut versus current approved intent and current authorization clocks.
Legacy 1.0 conformance, missing trusted study opt-in, and refusal by consequential admission/publication/delivery ports.
risks: Using a supported claim or not_required label for an unqualified model interpretation launders uncertainty into source authority.
Existing 1.0 result and baseline fields require native assessments; reusing them dishonestly would fabricate provenance even in capture-only mode.
Score jitter or changed execution IDs must not become new material; real source corrections and deadlines must still survive duplicate/handled suppression.
A second policy engine would drift from core freshness and attention rules; reuse existing ports and share any necessary neutral mechanics.
A release target or draft field name is not an installed capability, owner-approved threshold, receiving acceptance or production authorization.

reuse.application: Reuse guarded intent/candidate binding, private audience packet, durable execution and isolated handoff; keep the existing project() path's native decision requirement.
Consume real current execution provenance and existing explicitly unqualified admission rather than making a certificate or trusting detached probabilities.
Preserve mechanical attention, feedback, currentness/invalidation and real access controls without civic/provider vocabulary in the common core.
Host retains its deterministic approved-intent fallback until an implemented, pinned capture admission is available; it owns dispatch/capture mapping and receiving acceptance.

sources: Owner-relayed KS-1124 request, 2026-10-31: a Matter-owned capture-only path driven by unqualified monitoring judgments, with unchanged currentness/budget/receipt/access guards; name its ticket, version and wire/HostMonitoringState differences. Current host deterministic intent-field rule is not_required; model answers remain unqualified notes.

Owner/KS-1124 consumer implementation approval, 2026-10-31: PR #31 ffdb9a4 accepted; deterministic fallback uses only approved objective fields and event. Require vectors before freeze, exported identity, source sharing/per-audience access, typed study reuse and no default thresholds.

evidence: Matter implementation candidate 1f525c6a66593573f2ae5d2af1eaf2bd00460a35: 74 scoped installed-wheel checks passed (72 bounded-path/fast, one legacy reuse, one explicit control-conflict recovery), zero failures/errors/skips; final two-round code and recovery-test reviews have zero findings/warnings. docs/validation/MAT-084.md and docs/adapters/statecivics-capture-sdk-handoff.md pin the full dev16 wheel hash, 204 byte-equal packaged files, six recorded installed-runtime vectors and actual earlier checkpoints. Ticket stays in_progress/not_run until KS-1124 image acceptance and 1.1 freeze; no live JEV calls, qualification, receiving acceptance, production delivery or merge claimed.
